answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, join a Semaphore identity tree, and evaluate an epoch polynomial committed with a polynomial-identity proof. RLN rate-limits each identity: a valid message consumes a nullifier, while duplicate messaging in one epoch exposes distinct Shamir-derived shares whose interpolation reveals the private key. The protocol rejects the proofs and instantly slashes collateral; karst, lagoon, and pearl are domain-separated challenge labels.
